using Xunit;
using Moq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;

namespace MediaBrowser.MediaEncoding.Encoder
{
    public class MediaEncoderTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task TestLogWarning()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<MediaEncoder>>();
            var mediaEncoder = new MediaEncoder(loggerMock.Object, null, null, null, null, null, null);
            var ex = new Exception("Test exception");
            var options = new EncodingOptions();
            options.HardwareAccelerationType = HardwareAccelerationType.videotoolbox;
            var jobState = new EncodingJobState();
            var vidEncoder = "h264_videotoolbox";
            var inputArg = "-i input.mp4";
            var filterParam = "scale=640:480";
            var threads = 4;
            var qualityScale = 4;
            var priority = ProcessPriorityClass.Normal;
            var cancellationToken = CancellationToken.None;

            // Act
            try
            {
                await mediaEncoder.ExtractVideoImagesOnIntervalInternal(
                    (true ? "-skip_frame nokey " : string.Empty) + inputArg,
                    filterParam,
                    vidEncoder,
                    threads,
                    qualityScale,
                    priority,
                    cancellationToken).ConfigureAwait(false);
            }
            catch (FfmpegException)
            {
                mediaEncoder.LogWarning(ex, "I-frame trickplay extraction failed, will attempt standard way. Input: {InputFile}", "input.mp4");
            }

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogWarning(It.IsAny<Exception>(), "I-frame trickplay extraction failed, will attempt standard way. Input: {InputFile}", "input.mp4"), Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
